title: Kehtay Hain Rookay Sarwar, Aawaz Do Aye Akbar
body:
Kehtay hain rookay Sarwar, aawaz do aye Akbar
Aata hunn ranko beta, khatay huway mai thookar
1. Jaakar mai kya kahoonga laila se ye batado Akbar haye Akbar
Hai muntazir tumhari qaimay ke dar pa madar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Gurbat me tera laasha kaise uthaoun tanha Akbar haye Akbar
Thamay huway kamar ko ye kah rahe hai Sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Laila ki hai tamanna Zainab ki aarzo hai Akbar haye Akbar
Laye dulhan wo ek din Akbar teri biyah kar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Akbar teri judai sugra na seh sakegi Akbar haye Akbar
Taa umr tere gham me tadpegi teri khwahar.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Maqtal ki sar zameen ye ro ro ke keh rahi hai. Akbar haye Akbar
Sooti hai noujawani barchi jigar pa khakar.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ghazi ke gham se pahle tooti meri kamar hai Akbar haye Akbar
Beta tumhare gham se dil may bapa hai mehshar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kadyal jawan ka sar tha humraha humsafar may Akbar haye Akbar
Ahle haram ke dil par yunn chalraha tha qanjar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Koi nahi tha jouher nusrat ko shai ki jisdam Akbar haye Akbar
Sunkar sadaye halminn jhoole se aaye asgher
Azz: Jawad Ali jouher
